description: Implement constituency-filtered dashboards for reviewers. When a user with role='reviewer' has a constituency assigned, filter their applications list (GET /api/applications) and dashboard stats (GET /api/dashboard/stats) to show only applications for bursaries in their constituency. Admin users see all applications (no filter). Add a visual banner on the reviewer dashboard and applications page showing 'Your Constituency: [Name]'. Add constituency badge to application cards/rows.
steps: In backend/app/main.py, modify the list_applications function (GET /api/applications endpoint, around line ~214). After the existing role-based filter 'if user.role == "applicant"', add: 'elif user.role == "reviewer" and user.constituency: query = query.join(Application.bursary).where(Bursary.constituency == user.constituency)'. This joins the Bursary table and filters by matching constituency. Admin users skip this filter and see all.

In backend/app/main.py, modify the dashboard_stats function (GET /api/dashboard/stats endpoint, around line ~245). Add the same constituency filter for reviewers: after the existing count queries, wrap each in an if/else: 'if user.role == "reviewer" and user.constituency: base_query = select(Application).join(Application.bursary).where(Bursary.constituency == user.constituency); total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(base_query.subquery())); [apply same filter to all status counts and duplicate_flags count]; bursaries = db.scalar(select(func.count(Bursary.id)).where(Bursary.constituency == user.constituency, Bursary.active.is_(True)))'. For admin or reviewer without constituency, use existing unfiltered queries.

In frontend/src/App.jsx, locate the Dashboard component (around line with PageHeading 'Good day, administrator'). After the PageHeading and before the stat-grid, add: {user.constituency &&
Your Constituency: {user.constituency}
}. Import MapPin from lucide-react if not already imported.

In frontend/src/App.jsx, locate the ApplicationsPage component. Add the same constituency banner after the PageHeading (around where the toolbar is) if staff && user.constituency: {staff && user.constituency &&
Filtering by constituency: {user.constituency}
}

In frontend/src/App.jsx, in the ApplicationsPage table rows (tbody tr), after the bursary name td, add a new td (only for staff view) that shows the constituency badge: {staff && {a.bursary?.constituency || 'General'}}. Add corresponding Constituency in the thead row (only when staff is true).

Verify that application_out function in backend/app/main.py includes bursary object with constituency field. If not, modify application_out to return bursary_constituency: a.bursary.constituency in the returned dict, and update ApplicationOut schema in schemas.py to include bursary_constituency: str field.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/applications as a reviewer with constituency='Webuye East' returns only applications for bursaries with constituency='Webuye East'
GET /api/applications as admin returns all applications regardless of constituency
GET /api/applications as reviewer without constituency assigned returns all applications
GET /api/dashboard/stats as reviewer with constituency returns counts scoped to that constituency only
GET /api/dashboard/stats as admin returns global counts
Dashboard page (for reviewers with constituency) shows 'Your Constituency: [Name]' banner at the top
Applications page (for reviewers with constituency) shows 'Filtering by constituency: [Name]' banner
Application table rows in staff view show constituency badge/column with the bursary's constituency name
verification: Create a reviewer account via POST /api/admin/users with constituency='Webuye East'
Login as that reviewer, navigate to Dashboard, verify banner shows 'Your Constituency: Webuye East'
Navigate to Applications page, verify banner appears and only applications for Webuye East bursaries are shown
Check dashboard stats, verify counts reflect only Webuye East applications
Login as admin, verify no constituency banner appears and all applications are visible
Verify application rows in staff view show constituency badge with bursary constituency name
